rationale: The three-condition 450-run study isolates ABRL workflow mechanisms under one common runner. It is not, by itself, a comparison with a current end-to-end autoformalization system. This separate calibration tests contact with a pinned public workflow while preserving the versioned pre-execution-amended protocol and estimand.

system.name: LeanFlow
system.paper_title: LeanFlow: A Case Study in Workflow-Driven Lean Autoformalization

design.stage_0_result_free: Audit the pinned system interface, source and blueprint inputs, provider adapter, completion rule, logs, and build gate. Record every incompatibility with the ABRL challenge contract before making a model call.
design.stage_1_real_infrastructure_smoke: Run exactly one source-faithful case with the same frozen provider, model, toolchain, common task and source bytes, pre-audit workspace base, checker, and wall and cost ceilings. LeanFlow may receive only its pinned system-general workflow assets; mark the smoke permanently result-ineligible.
design.stage_2_external_calibration: If stage 1 passes, freeze a separate schedule over the same 30 challenge cases at replicate index zero. Reuse the hidden requirement assignment, neutral post-hoc checker, expert rubric, and blinded artifact normalization. Do not pool these runs into the 450-run primary analysis.
design.selected_replicate_rule: replicate index zero is shared across all 30 cases and was fixed before any primary-study or LeanFlow model outcome was observed

hidden_variant_balance.assignment: the primary suite parity rule evaluated at replicate index zero

design.run_identity_rule: Each external semantic run is identified by (case_id, leanflow_external, replicate_index=0) and is disjoint from every three-condition primary semantic run ID.
prespecified_contrasts: leanflow_external minus abrl at replicate index zero, reported by hidden variant and stratum as a system-level descriptive contrast
leanflow_external minus source_aware_blueprint at replicate index zero, reported by hidden variant and stratum as a system-level descriptive contrast
design.forbidden_contrast_selection: Do not compare only against the post-hoc best or worst internal condition, and do not select a headline contrast after observing either study.
design.missing_run_policy: No replacement and no outcome imputation. Paired descriptive differences require 30/30 externally checked runs and their 60 matched internal records; otherwise report only run-level artifacts and missingness by cause, condition, hidden variant, paper cluster, and textbook target.
required_fairness_bindings: same provider, immutable model attestation, reasoning effort, and service tier
same pre-audit workspace base and source PDF bytes
same per-run wall-clock and maximum-cost ceilings
same hidden source-faithful and injected-drift requirement bodies
same neutral checker, exact-contract rubric, grader blinding, and missing-run disclosure
exact LeanFlow workflow command and mode, with research, web, and public-repository search disabled
single agent, no human review, and fresh user, project, and checkpoint state for every run with no cross-run resume
one frozen provider, model, and settings tuple for every foreground, manager, planner, advisor, and compression invocation
same Lean, Lake, Mathlib, cache, CPU, memory, PID, concurrency, retry, replacement, and imputation boundaries
explicit accounting for project initialization, REPL, MCP, LeanExplore, and every bootstrap surface
same common task, source bytes, proposed requirement body, pre-audit workspace base, checker, and resource ceilings across systems

each system may use only its own system-general workflow assets frozen before the challenge; case-specific and cross-system assets are forbidden, and system-specific repository views and theorem-card availability are disclosed rather than claimed equal
separate reporting of framework-native API and tool calls whose semantics are not interchangeable
all provider calls, including auxiliary framework roles, count toward the same token and dated-price cost ledger
reported_endpoints: input and output tokens when exposed by the provider client
model cost under one dated price schedule
framework-native API and build counts, reported without relabeling them as ABRL tool calls
design.dependence_boundary: The 30 cases comprise eighteen probes clustered within three paper sources and twelve textbook targets; they are not 30 independent sources or papers.
design.analysis_boundary: Report exact run-level outcomes, stratum counts, and the two pre-specified paired descriptive differences only after the complete-run gate. The contrasts compare complete systems under common tasks and resource ceilings; they are not mechanism-level resource-equated comparisons because system-general workflow assets and repository views may differ. This single-replicate calibration is exploratory: no p-value, winner/rank, bold-best table, superiority, equivalence, noninferiority, powered comparison, or selective headline is permitted. Do not combine it with the primary interval or p-values and do not reinterpret framework-specific event counts as identical measurements.
design.extension_rule: Any multi-replicate confirmatory LeanFlow comparison requires a new frozen protocol and budget before observing stage-2 outcomes. It cannot be added selectively after favorable or unfavorable results.

execution_gate: pin and archive the exact LeanFlow source tree and dependency lock
complete the result-free interface and fairness audit
freeze an adapter that preserves LeanFlow-native evidence without granting extra source or network access
pass the permanently result-ineligible real-infrastructure smoke
freeze the 30-run schedule, prices, budgets, image digests, graders, and analysis script
nonclaims: No LeanFlow model run has been executed for ABRL.
No numerical comparison with LeanFlow is reported.
This plan does not reproduce or re-estimate the numerical results in the LeanFlow paper; it targets the pinned public repository commit under the ABRL challenge contract.
The plan does not establish that ABRL outperforms LeanFlow or any other system.
The planned external calibration does not replace the unrun 450-run mechanism study.
